text:
Nora: Heads-up: MeterStack sent invoice MS-2026-03 for $14,200 but it looks like the pilot month (Feb) and the annual renewal (Mar) overlapped. Link: https://meterstack.example/invoice/MS-2026-03
Diego: Can you drop the invoice lines + PO? Need to map to CT-2025-MSTK in our system. cc @Priya
Nora: Lines:
```
Item: MeterStack Pilot Feb 2026 - $4,200
Item: MeterStack Annual Renewal Mar 2026 - $10,000
Tax: $0
Total: $14,200
PO: PO-100442
```
Priya: Opening vendor dispute. Proposed asks: (A) pro-rata credit for pilot ($4.2k) OR convert to account credit applied to next billing, (B) change billing to monthly-in-arrears with net-45 starting 2026-05-01, (C) add a 5% committed-volume discount if we commit to 3mo reserved capacity. Which option does finance prefer?
Marta: Finance prefers credit note over refunds. Net-45 is fine. For committed discount we need committed usage numbers from Diego; also need forecast impact to cash flow.
Diego: Forecast attached in ticket TKT-5968. Feb spike due to benchmarking runs (run-8872). Not ongoing. I'll attach logs and the usage query.
procurement-bot: Ticket TKT-5968 created "MeterStack double-charge + cadence/discount ask" assigned to Priya. SLA 72h.
finance-bot: Note: accepting credit notes requires GL entry code CC-ADV-2026. If credit note > $3k route through AP hold.
Priya: @legal-bot pls pre-approve amendment wording for monthly-in-arrears net-45 + credit note in lieu of refund. We'll ask MeterStack to issue credit note and sign amendment. Aim to close by Apr 15 to avoid AP reconciliation churn.
legal-bot: Will review and send redline by EOD. Include contract ref CT-2025-MSTK.
Nora: Thanks team. Closing owners: @Priya (procurement), @Marta (finance), @Diego (usage verification). Ill follow up in TKT-5968 and post updates here. :thumbsup:
